Class Trick

java.lang.Object
org.engine.contract.trick.Trick
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayArea
public class Trick extends Object implements PlayArea
An immutable record of one trick: the cards played so far and the order they were played.

A trick starts empty, grows one card at a time via with(Player, Card), and is complete once all four players have played. The winner is the player who played the highest card of the led suit.

    • with

      public Trick with(Player player, Card card)
      Returns a new trick instance with the given card added for the specified player. This operation does not mutate the current instance.
      Parameters:
      player - the player making the move
      card - the card being played
      Returns:
      a new Trick instance containing the appended turn
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the trick is already complete
      IllegalArgumentException - if this player has already played in this trick
